name: IC Power Switching Regulator — 3.3V, 13.2V — Converter
description: IC power switching regulator cluster for 3.3V and 13.2V applications using SMD TRACO TDN 5 DCDC Converter footprints.
selection_hints: Select when operating with 3.3V and 13.2V voltage facets.
Use for designs requiring SMD mounting for DCDC converter modules.
Verify layout compatibility with the Converter_DCDC_TRACO_TDN_5-xxxxWISM_SMD footprint.
avoid_when: Avoid if through-hole or non-SMD mounting is required.
Do not use if the board layout requires a footprint other than TRACO TDN 5-xxxxWISM Converter.
Avoid if system voltages differ from the specified 3.3V and 13.2V facets.
